en: Sepia-toned image of an interior exhibition room or showroom. Along the back wall is a large panoramic winter mural or diorama depicting snow-covered mountains, dense pine forests, and a horse‑drawn sleigh gliding through deep snow. In the foreground are glass display cases with objects, shelves filled with bottles and artifacts, a table with chairs, and a framed portrait at the center. The overall appearance suggests an early‑20th‑century museum or fair pavilion highlighting alpine or winter culture.
